```plato

    // The rotation of the three Tait-Bryan angles, applied roll then pitch then
    // yaw (yaw about Y, pitch about X, roll about Z).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conversion_between_quaternions_and_Euler_angles
    CreateFromYawPitchRoll(_: Quaternion, yaw: Angle, pitch: Angle, roll: Angle): Quaternion {
        var hr = roll * 0.5;
        var hp = pitch * 0.5;
        var hy = yaw * 0.5;
        var sr = hr.Sin;
        var cr = hr.Cos;
        var sp = hp.Sin;
        var cp = hp.Cos;
        var sy = hy.Sin;
        var cy = hy.Cos;
        return (cy * sp * cr + sy * cp * sr,
                sy * cp * cr - cy * sp * sr,
                cy * cp * sr - sy * sp * cr,
                cy * cp * cr + sy * sp * sr);
    }
```
